body:
Acknowledged. derivationId stays (recipe identity; goldens must not move). I will add BasisId as a content digest of ordered basis unit ids plus basis kind, carry it on derived-track provenance, and fold it into outputSpaceId = f(derivationId, basisId). Caches keyed on derivationId become (derivationId, basisId). Codec/features.scala untouched unless a wire field is required, and I will announce first.

Reading the three reserved files for a design checkpoint before any hardening. No edits yet.
